title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Work and GPT Live, transforming AI #openai #chatgptwork #aitech
description: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work, a powerful new tool that integrates with Slack, Drive, email, and CRMs to automate tasks and workflows independently. It transforms goals into completed work by accessing apps directly and running processes on a schedule, significantly boosting team efficiency. OpenAI also introduced a three-tier intelligence system with Sol as the most advanced model, Terra as a cost-effective middle option, and Luna designed for high-speed, large-scale tasks. These capabilities are unified in a single app, merging Chat, Work, and Codex into one seamless platform, allowing skills and projects to be shared effortlessly. Additionally, OpenAI unveiled Sites for easy sharing of Work-created dashboards and portals that update automatically based on source data changes. The new GPT Live voice model supports simultaneous listening and speaking, enabling natural conversation flow and handing off complex queries to smarter models in real time. Together, these innovations represent a shift from chatbots to collaborative software that works alongside users. #OpenAI #ChatGPTWork #GPTLive #AIworkflow #AIAutomation #SolModel #TerraModel #LunaModel #OpenAIlaunch #ArtificialIntelligence #ProductivityAI #ChatGPT #AIDevelopment #TechInnovation #SoftwareAutomation
